name: Secrets of the Colossus - Zora
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
My servants were nearly killed in their efforts to recover this sample. You absolutely must hurry! Lord Maxwell Tyrosus eagerly awaits a fresh husk sample. He believes that the secrets of this Colossus could help us in the war against the Scourge!

Why are you still here!? To Light's Hope! Yes, you will be rewarded handsomely for your efforts...
narrative.objectives: Take the Colossus of Zora's Husk to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent and timely! Well done, lad.
narrative.requestItemsText: You look a bit heavy in the boots, friend.
